title: Forging the Magic Anvil
description: A hooded blacksmith stands at a stone base holding a hammer and parchment, looking up at a glowing blue crystal being forged on an anvil by a pair of tongs. Blue magical energy drips from the crystal and a floating arcane circle above, surrounded by flying blue birds against a wall covered in glowing runes and symbols.
prompt: A hooded blacksmith in a leather apron stands before a massive anvil on a stone base, holding a hammer and ancient parchment with diagrams. A pair of tongs holds a glowing blue crystalline object above the anvil as bright blue magical liquid drips down. A large arcane circle with symbols floats overhead dripping blue energy, while blue ethereal birds fly around a stone wall covered in glowing runes and occult symbols, dramatic fantasy atmosphere.
